items.text: Goldman Sachs finds workers laid off from AI-exposed jobs since 2025 took about a month longer to find new work, and were about 10 points likelier to still be jobless a year later.
Alphabet's shares closed down 12.64% after its results, a loss of approximately $499.8 billion, as investors doubted its AI spending (about $51.4 billion in the quarter).
North Carolina's governor's task force says big data centers could add $50 billion in energy costs by 2050 without policy changes.
